basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Alex, a 16-year-old student from a bustling neighborhood in Mumbai. I'm super into strategy games, especially anything by Warlord Games, and I have a not-so-secret obsession with the Avatar series, especially anything related to Kyoshi. Lately, I've been getting hyped about this new game, Mumbai Gullies. I usually browse Reddit during the evening after school, which is when I have some downtime. I'm currently single, but as you might have guessed, I'm navigating the thrilling and terrifying world of teenage crushes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Mostly self-taught in areas like strategy gaming and pop culture. I spend a good amount of time watching YouTube videos and joining online forums to learn more about my hobbies. I've also picked up a bit about urban lifestyle and trends from living in a vibrant city like Mumbai.
